title: Completed scalar restriction preserves horizontal section maps
statement: Let ell be prime, E a finite extension of Q_ell, W a scheme, and M a module sheaf on the vertical coefficient sequence site [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site]. For positive levels n+1 <= m+1, the map on sections of the completed-scalar restriction tower of M is heterogeneously equal to the original horizontal map of M [def-pur-strict-quotient-expressions]. This is an equality of the actual section functions, including their domains, and requires no flatness assumption.

proof.text: Apply the horizontal-map clause in the unique characterization coefficientSequenceRestriction_exists to M, m, n, the inequality and the site object. It identifies the restricted tower map with the original module-presheaf map.

proof.text: The module-presheaf map and its underlying additive-presheaf map agree by PresheafOfModules.presheaf_map_apply_coe. Extend this pointwise identity to the section functions and compose its heterogeneous equality with the preceding characterization. By the definition of horizontal this is the claimed formula.

lean.statement:
theorem completedHorizontal {W : Scheme.{t}}
    (M : coefficientSequenceModules l E W) (m n : ℕ) (hmn : n ≤ m)
    (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ) :
    HEq (fun x ↦ ((((coefficientSequenceRestriction l E W).obj M).map
      (homOfLE hmn).op).val.app U) x)
      (fun x : M.val.obj (op (m, U.unop)) ↦
        horizontal l E M hmn U.unop x)
